# OCR components

Tesseract.js 6.0.1: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js (Apache-2.0; see TESSERACT-JS-LICENSE)

Tesseract.js-core: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core (see TESSERACT-CORE-LICENSE).

English and Korean trained language data distributed by https://tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0/ are based on Tesseract tessdata, licensed under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata/blob/main/LICENSE. The files are included locally so uploaded photos do not need to leave the browser.
